units: <cite ref="Chagigah 15a:5">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite> … <he>למעלה לא עמידה ולא י׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) on high there is no standing up and no sitting down (effort and rest), no emulation &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 69b:1">Yoma 69ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין י׳ בעזרה</he> none were allowed to sit down in the Temple court.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:7">Gen. R. s. 38</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל מקום שאתח מוצא י׳ וכ׳</he> wherever you find sitting (retirement, use of the word <he>ישב</he>) recorded in the Bible, there Satan leaps forth (trouble arises).

Yeb. 106ᵃ יְשִׁיבָתָהּ זו היא עמידתה this her sitting is to her a getting up (sitting up is to her a great effort; oth. expl.: her being left seated, is her erection, i.e. her failure to be married to the yabam is a benefit to her); a. fr.
<cite ref="Ketubot 110b:4">Keth. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>יְשִׁיבַת כרכים קשה</he> living in large cities is a hardship.
<cite ref="Shabbat 10b:8">Sabb. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>עיר שיְשִׁיבָתָהּ קרובה</he> a town of recent settlement; a. fr.
<cite ref="Yoma 28b:8">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>זקן ויושב בי׳</he> an elder and member of council.
<cite ref="Yoma 28b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>לא פרשה י׳ מהם</he> they (our early ancestors) were never without council (a representative body).
<cite ref="Pesachim 119a:1">Pes. 119ᵃ</cite> top <he>המכיר … בי׳</he> who knows his colleague’s place in meetings; … <he>המקבל בי׳</he> who greets his colleague in meetings with kindness.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:33">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ</cite> top <he>ומינו את ר״א … בי׳</he> they elected R. El. … (president) in regular session.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>הושיבו … בי׳</he> they installed him as president.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 120a:4">B. Bath. 120ᵃ</cite> <he>בי׳ הלך וכ׳</he> in court or college give the preference to learning, in social entertainment to age; a. fr.—<he>י׳ של מעלה</he> divine court.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:9">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>נתבקש בי׳ של מ׳</he> has been summoned before divine justice (is dead); a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְשִׁיבוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:8">Koh. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>אפשר שהי׳ הללו טועות וכ׳</he> is it possible that those colleges be lost in such futile errors; <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 2:24">Tosef. Ḥull. II, 24</cite> <he>שהסיבו הללו טועים</he> (corr. acc.; v., however, <cite ref="O00530"><he>סֵיבוּ</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 10:5:2">Y. Sabb. X, 12ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>שימשתי את אבא עומדות מה שלא שמשת י׳</he> I have served my father at more ‘standing meetings’ (standing up as an Amora) than you have served at college sessions; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:1:2">Y. Ḥag. III, beg. 78ᵈ</cite>; a. fr.
